prompt: Diels–Alder of 1,3-butadiene + methyl acrylate (methyl 2-propenoate). Draw the cyclohexene product.
explanation: Butadiene (as the diene) locks s-cis, and the acrylate acts as the dienophile. [4+2] creates a six-membered ring with the new C=C sitting between the diene's internal carbons. The CO2Me ends up on a sp3 carbon of the new ring.
